name: Breadcrumb
description:
The universal breadcrumb (R6.4): one line at --control-h-sm in the top bar. Every crumb
but the current one navigates; a crumb with siblings carries a switcher. It collapses
against its own width — first the middle crumbs, then to `‹ parent · current` — and each
crumb truncates with an ellipsis at a maximum width. `size="xs"` is the compact form for a
path within a pane; it folds the same way within its own box.
signature: ({ items, renderLink, collapse, header, scope, size: sizeProp, className, "aria-label": labelProp }: BreadcrumbProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: aria-label
props.description:
Accessible name when a visible label does not name the control. The default form is named
"Breadcrumb"; the compact form falls back to "Path", so supply what the path is ("File path")
and never a name that claims to be the route breadcrumb.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: collapse
props.description:
"auto" (default): measured, full → middle → compact → current. "current": always only the
current crumb with the trail in its popup (a host that has measured, as the top bar does
through BreadcrumbFoldContext).

props.name: header
props.description: First in the trail popup when the context is folded into it: the module switch.

props.name: items
props.description: Root first, current place last. Feed it from the router's matches.

props.name: renderLink
props.description: Renders crumbs with `link` as router links (RouteBreadcrumb supplies this).

props.name: scope
props.description: The scope row above the trail when folded into it: the organisation.

props.name: size
props.description:
"sm" (default): the route breadcrumb, one line at `--control-h-sm`, in the top bar. "xs": a
compact path inside a pane, one line at `--control-h-xs` with label-size type, for content
rather than the route (a file's folders in an editor pane, R6.4). It folds within its own
box like the default and never replaces or repeats the route breadcrumb. Name it with
`aria-label`.
